## Progress

- Merged [PR #32](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/32): `tests/e2e` Playwright specs J1–J6 read from the storyboard (42 steps as `fixme`, tagged with screen and milestone); P0 shell checks pass in CI

## Description

Walk the clinical advisor through J1–J6 on the designs/staging storyboard and capture sign-off or change requests. Create tests/e2e journey specs (J1–J6) as skeletons: P0 implements the steps that exist (sign-in, role navigation, invite); remaining steps are marked test.fixme with the screen ID and phase so each later phase turns them green.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Clinical advisor sign-off (or a list of requested changes with owners) for each of J1–J6 is recorded in docs/02-design/journeys.md with date.
- [ ] **AC2.** tests/e2e contains one spec per journey with every step from the storyboard, referencing screen IDs; P0 steps pass, later steps are fixme with phase tags.
- [ ] **AC3.** Any change requested by the advisor is raised as a ticket in the relevant phase before P1 scope freeze.
- [ ] **AC4.** The P0 exit gate item "Clinical advisor walks all six journeys and signs off" is evidenced.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
